correctness.rationale: For K=k in a uniform n-map, fixing the k cyclic roots and their permutation leaves k n^(m−1) rooted forests, m=n−k; deleting r prescribed nonroot terminal vertices and independently choosing their parents gives k(n−r)^(m−1), including m=1 and r=m. The ratio yields all falling-factorial moments, unique bounded conditional law and exact inclusion-exclusion PMF. With q=1−1/n the mean g(m)=m q^(m−1) increases strictly in m=0..n−1 because g(m+1)−g(m)=q^(m−1)[1−(m+1)/n]>0; therefore Cov(K,L)<0 for all n≥2. P(K≥k)=(n)_k/n^k and Rayleigh moment convergence, together with h_n(k)=n/e+(1−k²/n)/(2e)+an L²-controlled O(n^(−1/2)) remainder at k=K_n, give Cov(K,L)=−sqrt(pi/2) sqrt(n)/(2e)+o(sqrt n). The separate exact occupancy variance gives Var(L)/n→e^(−1)−2e^(−2), and Rayleigh variance gives Var(K)/n→(4−pi)/2. Independent exhaustive re-enumeration n=2..6 and an exact deletion identity corroborate finite statements, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The cyclic core and zero-indegree terminals are canonically defined random-mapping statistics on disparate sqrt(n) and n scales. Their strict negative finite-n association and exact sharp sqrt(n) covariance are natural, not arbitrary slices, and quantify why the correlation vanishes at rate n^(−1/2) despite persistent negative dependence. The finite conditional occupancy distribution is classical as a corollary of Pitman and cannot alone establish new value; the distinct signed mixed-asymptotic constant supplies the motivatED additional result. No generalization or publication-sized advance is needed for this exact natural invariant; work does not assert full stochastic dominance or a nonuniform mapping theorem.

limitations: Uniform mapping only, self-loops allowed; no conditional full stochastic order or nonuniform model covered.
